newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Oct 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Oct 16.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Wednesday:
- U.S. freight railroad company Conrail Inc has agreed to merge with railroad company CSX Corp in a deal worth $8.4 billion.
- Japan begins a national experiment designed to create a more responsive political system as elections approach next Sunday.
